passage:
psychologist — 心理学家
The project, called 'Recall and Reason', was designed by a local psychologist, Dr.

participants — 参与者
As part of the study, participants were asked to describe a short film they had watched together.

insisted — 坚持说
For example, one woman insisted that the man had been wearing a hat, although he had not.

confident — 自信的
The workshop then focused on the difference between confident memories and accurate memories.

accurate — 准确的
The workshop then focused on the difference between confident memories and accurate memories.

implications — 影响，含义
This finding has important implications for legal testimony.

witnesses — 证人
In court, witnesses are often asked to recall events months or years later, by which time their memories may have changed considerably.

recommended — 建议
She also recommended that line-ups should be conducted fairly, with similar-looking people, to avoid unfair identification.
